facts.statement: A news item on the official Free Realms site promoted a new TV commercial tied to the Halloween Super Spooktacular, in Spanish ('Un Espacio en la TV').
facts.quote: Un Espacio en la TV – Halloween Super Spooktacular

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This Wayback copy of the freerealms.com 'What is New?' news page shows only a single news item: a Spanish-language TV commercial headlined 'Un Espacio en la TV – Halloween Super Spooktacular', with the text '¡Checa nuestro nuevo comercial de TV!'. The page gives a relative posting time ('7 months, 1 week ago') rather than an absolute date, and no details of the event or commercial beyond the title. The rest is site navigation.
